description: Defines constants, types, and function prototypes for a markdown parser, including extension flags, renderer callbacks, and document management functions.

methods.name: hoedown_document_new
methods.description: Allocates a new markdown document processor instance with specified renderer, extensions, and nesting level.

methods.name: hoedown_document_render
methods.description: Renders markdown data into output buffer using the document processor.

methods.name: hoedown_document_render_inline
methods.description: Renders inline markdown data into output buffer.

methods.name: hoedown_document_free
methods.description: Deallocates the markdown document processor instance.
